pages.text: Build a 5x5 pattern around a Blank Magic Center, then strike the center with a Ritual Dagger.$(br2)A = Attack, D = Defense, R = Regeneration, C = Center, X = empty. Patterns may be rotated. Every unmarked position must remain empty. The completed center needs spirit-stone fuel.

pages.title: Forcefield Center
pages.text: DXDXD$(br)XDRDX$(br)DXCXD$(br)XDRDX$(br)DXDXD$(br2)Always blocks lightning. Also blocks ownerless, mob-owned, and blacklisted-player projectiles and ranged attack entities, plus blacklisted players, their other attacks, and enabled mob categories. Nonblacklisted players and non-lightning attacks they own pass freely. Outside explosions cannot destroy blocks inside the field. An expanding boundary carries blocked nearby entities outward. Items and experience pass. Spirit stones absorb 10/100/1000 damage; an unfueled broken ward explodes.

pages.title: Scorching Center
pages.text: AXXXA$(br)XAXAX$(br)RXCXR$(br)XAXAX$(br)AXXXA$(br2)Burns and damages enemies each second, drains 1% maximum Qi, removes Frozen effects, reduces healing, strengthens fire techniques, and raises ice-technique cost.

pages.title: Sanctuary Center
pages.text: RXRXR$(br)XXDXX$(br)RXCXR$(br)XXDXX$(br)RXRXR$(br2)Grants Regeneration II, restores 1% maximum Qi each second, improves natural Qi recovery, shortens fire, and removes minor Poison and Weakness.

pages.title: Frost Center
pages.text: DXRXD$(br)XDXDX$(br)AXCXA$(br)XRXRX$(br)DXRXD$(br2)Slows, extinguishes, freezes, and applies Frozen Qi. Qi recovery is halved and spell costs rise. Fire techniques erode Frozen Qi.

pages.title: Decay Center
pages.text: AXRXA$(br)XAXAX$(br)RXCXR$(br)XAXAX$(br)AXRXA$(br2)Inflicts Wither and Weakness, reduces healing, and raises healing-technique cost. Corpse and Blood Demon cultivators resist part of the effect.

pages.title: Thunder Center
pages.text: AXDXA$(br)XRXRX$(br)AXCXA$(br)XXDXX$(br)AXXXA$(br2)Every 3 seconds, strikes the hostile target with the most Qi for 20 magic damage plus 1% maximum health. Wet and frozen targets take more. Blocks never ignite.

pages.title: Detection Center
pages.text: DXAXD$(br)XRXRX$(br)AXCXA$(br)XXDXX$(br)AXXXD$(br2)Reveals intruders and hostile mobs, reports player name and realm once per entry, marks souls, grants Spirit Sight to permitted players, and exposes nearby disguises.

pages.title: Reforge Blade Formation
pages.text: RXXXR$(br)XDXDX$(br)RXCXR$(br)XDXDX$(br)RXXXR$(br2)Place a damageable weapon in the extra weapon slot. While enabled and fueled, the weapon floats above the center and restores 1 durability each second.

pages.title: Teleport Center
pages.text: XAXAX$(br)DXRXD$(br)XRCRX$(br)DXRXD$(br)XAXAX$(br2)Joins a code-based network of permanent Teleport Centers. This formation has no passive fuel drain and consumes its teleport fuel only when a teleport completes. Its glyph glows only while enabled, fueled, and a living non-spectator player is inside its radius.

pages.title: Formation Codes
pages.text: Open a permanent Teleport Center with an empty hand and choose Destinations. Every center has its own code and a Copy Code button. Paste that code into another center and press Add to save it as a destination. A center can save up to 32 destinations. Click a destination to select it; its Qi and center-energy cost per entity appears beside it. Press Teleport, or sneak-right-click the center with an empty hand, to travel to the selected destination.

pages.title: Temporary Endpoints
pages.text: A Zhenpan holding a Teleport Center can maintain two temporary Teleport Centers at once. Summon them with normal right-clicks away from a Teleport Center; the second endpoint automatically links two-way to the first. Each has its own countdown. Entities are teleported automatically when they enter either radius. Qi and center-energy fuel are charged to the Zhenpan owner, using spirit stones from that player's inventory; excess stone value remains in the source until it expires. An arrival must leave before it can trigger that endpoint again.

pages.title: Teleporting
pages.text: The owner or a control-whitelisted player must stand inside the radius and sneak-right-click the center with an empty hand. All entities in the radius teleport after 5 seconds. Leaving the radius or taking damage immediately cancels the charge and deactivates the combo.$(br2)Cost: 100 Qi per entity from the activator, plus 10 center energy per block of distance per entity.

pages.title: Teleport Flags
pages.text: Each Spirit Gathering Flag reduces teleport center-energy fuel by 25% and does not apply the normal ×1.5 flag-cost multiplier.$(br2)Each Haste Flag removes 2 seconds from charging, down to 0.5 seconds, but raises center-energy fuel by 30%. Other flags retain their normal ×1.5 fuel multiplier. Qi cost is unchanged.
